name: Clicks Pixels Manager | TikTok, Meta Facebook, Google Analytics GA4, Google Ads, GTM & WooCommerce Pixels Tracking
author: sykologicist

sections.description:
Clicks Pixels Manager is the ultimate, lightweight, and SEO-optimized conversion tracking plugin for WordPress. Easily inject, manage, and verify tracking pixels for TikTok Pixel, Meta (Facebook) Pixel, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), and Google Ads without writing a single line of code.

Ensure maximum tracking accuracy, improve ad delivery, and boost ROI on advertising campaigns across TikTok Ads, Meta Ads, and Google Ads. Engineered to load asynchronously, Clicks Pixels Manager guarantees fast page load speeds, keeping your Core Web Vitals healthy and helping your directory and search rankings.

Free Features

  • TikTok Pixel Integration: Effortlessly fire page views and standard WooCommerce conversion events.
  • Meta (Facebook) Pixel: Dynamic track PageView, ViewContent, AddToCart, and Purchase events.
  • Google Analytics 4 (GA4): Seamless tracking page views and core e-commerce events.
  • Google Tag Manager: Inject GTM container scripts safely in the header and body/footer areas.
  • Google Ads Conversion Tracking: Integrate Conversion ID and Conversion Label for purchase events.
  • Granular Exclusions: Exclude specific pages or posts, and toggles for logged-in admin users.
  • Import/Export Tool: Back up configurations or migrate settings easily in JSON format.
  • WooCommerce Auto-Sync: Dynamic e-commerce events tracking with exact value and currency mapping.

Pro Features

  • Custom Events Builder: Visually define conversion events based on clicks, page loads, scroll, or timers.
  • Meta Conversions API (CAPI): Send server-side event tracking directly to Meta to bypass adblockers.
  • Google Consent Mode v2: GDPR/EU compliant default consent states for storage and advertisements.
  • Multi-Pixel Triggering: Fire up to 5 Meta Pixels and 5 GA4 measurement IDs concurrently.
  • Role-Based Exclusions: Disable tracking individually for Editor, Shop Manager, or custom user roles.
  • Advanced WooCommerce Events: Track InitiateCheckout, AddPaymentInfo, Searches, and Categories.
  • UTM Campaign Tracking: Auto-persist UTM parameters across user sessions for attribution.
  • Live Event Debugger: Monitor triggered events, platforms, and parameters in real-time.

Visit Clicks.com.pk for premium web development and customization services.

Check out our other WordPress plugins:
* Clicks Advance Forms Builder — Zero-code responsive form builder.
* Clicks User Manager — Custom roles, login restrictions, and redirect rules.

External services

This plugin enqueues and triggers external tracking scripts depending on settings configured by the administrator:

  1. Meta (Facebook) Pixel: Loads scripting from connect.facebook.net to track user behavior, page views, and WooCommerce e-commerce actions: Meta Terms of Service | Meta Privacy Policy.
  2. Google Analytics 4 / Google Ads: Loads scripting from googletagmanager.com/gtag to track site traffic analytics and advertising conversion actions: Google Terms of Service | Google Privacy Policy.
  3. Google Tag Manager: Loads scripts and optionally triggers an iframe fallback from googletagmanager.com to manage third-party tags on your website: Google Tag Manager Terms of Service | Google Privacy Policy.
  4. TikTok Pixel: Loads scripting from analytics.tiktok.com to track site traffic and WooCommerce e-commerce actions: TikTok Terms of Service | TikTok Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/clicks-pixels-manager directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress admin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings -> Clicks Pixels to configure your tracking IDs.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin inject render-blocking scripts?

No. All tracking scripts enqueued by this plugin are optimized to load asynchronously and prevent page-load delays.

How do I exclude tracking for a specific page?

When editing any Page or Post, you will find a “Clicks Pixels Exclusions” meta box on the sidebar. Check the “Exclude this page/post from tracking pixels” option and save the page.

Does this plugin support TikTok Pixel?

Yes! The plugin fully integrates TikTok Pixel tracking, including standard page views and WooCommerce e-commerce conversion events (ViewContent, AddToCart, Purchase/CompletePayment).

What is Google Consent Mode v2?

Consent Mode v2 is a framework by Google that adjusts GA4 and Google Ads tag behavior based on visitor consent settings (analytics, advertisement, user data, personalization), ensuring compliance with EU/EEA regulations.

Why should I use Meta Conversions API (CAPI)?

Browser adblockers, iOS restrictions, and cookie expiry block up to 30% of standard browser-fired Meta Pixel events. Conversions API sends these events directly from your server to Meta, recovering lost tracking data.

Can I track multiple pixels concurrently?

Yes, the Pro version allows you to configure up to 5 additional Meta Pixel IDs and GA4 measurement IDs. Each ID receives the same events concurrently.

How does the Custom Events Builder work?

The Pro version includes a visual custom events builder where you can define triggers like CSS selector clicks, page visits, scroll depth, or timer delay, and fire custom conversion events automatically.
